title: Censored Barcelona Tour - a different take.
text: Aiden delivered a heartfelt, respectful and highly informative tour. We loved that we were able to learn and understand the real Barcelona. Highly recommended.
author: Ali V

title: Great Walking Tour of the Gothic Quarter
text: Had a great tour with Filipa around the Gothic quarter.  Love these types of tours as you get to walk with a guide and then get to choose how much of a tip to give after the tour is over.  There is some confusion.  On the website it suggests this tour is a tour of Barcelona and then when you book it said it was a 2 hour tour of the Gothic Quarter in Barcelona.  The tour was lovely but if you want to visit the Ramblas or Gaudi sites, this tour did not do that although the company offers tours that do.
author: jbushman2017

title: 3 Brits and a Catalan
text: Natalia was fantastic! Very funny and keep us all interested the whole way round. She also gave us loads of recommendations for food etc. Thanks Nat!

author: pqblof

title: Walking Tour
text:
We couldn’t recommend the walking tours more.  We did the free tour in the morning and the uncensored tour in the afternoon.  You see parts of Barcelona in the uncensored tour that you wouldn’t even know existed.  Aidan, who incidentally is the best tour guide I have ever come across, was so passionate and informative about everything Barcelona - both the history and more recent social/political context.  

Cathy & Mike
author: Cmg1964

title: Great tour
text: Our tour guide was Aidan and he knew so much about the city’s history and also where to visit during your stay. The tour itself was very interesting and we learnt a lot of quirky facts that we would never have know otherwise.

title: Free walking tour with Alesso
text: We enjoyed our tour with Alesso and we recommend it to the other visitors who want to learn about history and local life in the City.
author: Dilek A

title: Perfect way to experience the city
text: Being my first free walking tour, I wasn't sure what to expect but Marina gave an incredible insight into the history of Barcelona. There was so much to learn about and her extensive knowledge of the city was so engaging. Overall, it was such an enjoyable experience and I would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking to discover another side of Barcelona.
